description: REQ-BILL-012 specifies two paths: (1) new customer created -> payjp_customer_id saved immediately, (2) existing customer reused -> payjp_customer_id already present. PROP-BILL-032 only tests path (1) with injected post-customer failure to verify persistence survives. There is no PROP that explicitly tests the customer-reuse path (member already has payjp_customer_id from a previous failed subscription attempt where customer was created but subscription failed). This is a real scenario after inflight operation resolution.

evidence.snippet: PROP-BILL-032 | members.payjp_customer_id persisted immediately after customer creation, survives subsequent failure | REQ-BILL-012

sourceReference.snippet: New customer created -> payjp_customer_id saved immediately; Existing customer reused -> payjp_customer_id already present (no overwrite needed)

remediation: Add a PROP (or expand PROP-BILL-032) to test the customer-reuse path: set up a member with payjp_customer_id from a prior partial failure, then issue a new subscription request. Verify that no new PAY.JP customer is created and the existing customer_id is used for charge/subscription creation.
